cases.name: Default-off and denied readiness
steps: With an approved fixture, explicitly keep each new-feature flag off in turn; separately test real writer capability denied.
Visit the owned score page without a query activation shortcut.
observe: No new workspace read/data when flags are off; no v2 decision/undo controls when readiness is denied.
Owned diagnostics/read-only preview remain honest; null scores and private/no-store headers remain unchanged.

cases.name: Full review and keyboard acceptance
steps: Open a genuine admitted workspace and review exact before/after, saved JD quote, clause order, source citations and pinned input links.
Use keyboard to check a fresh acknowledgement and accept once.
observe: Unacknowledged acceptance is disabled; one exact v2 command is sent.
Actual correlated14-field receipt matches command/key/draft/base/JD; actual canonical edit then confirmation increments by2 and yields candidate-declared wording without direct source citations.
No score, proficiency or qualification gain is claimed; no automatic diagnostics refresh or new proposal/key.

cases.name: Rejection without head movement
steps: Reject a separately prepared actual proposal without an acceptance acknowledgement.
observe: Exact reject command omits reviewAcknowledgement.
Actual decision/event is recorded with base version/revision unchanged; no undo appears.

cases.name: Lost-ack acceptance and retained exact retry
steps: Allow the real server action to commit, verify that outcome independently, then suppress its response in the approved test boundary.
Move same-source current heads through a real owned operation so fresh workspace becomes null; retry manually with fresh acknowledgement.
If a later retry receives a known unavailable/stale envelope, retain the earlier ambiguous payload.
observe: Original command/key/wording/JD quote stay pinned; no automatic retry, rebase or new key.
Actual exact replay returns the original event/receipt before fresh-head conflict, with no second edit/confirmation.
Bridge remains mounted; later known errors do not prove the earlier request was not recorded.

cases.name: Fresh stale pair and current-access precedence
steps: Prepare a proposal, then change canonical or JD head through the actual owned path before the first submit.
Separately revoke current membership or prepare deletion before an exact replay.
observe: Fresh stale admission refuses atomically without a new event/head move.
Current access/privacy denial precedes replay; no foreign/private payload is returned.
Recovery is explicit review/navigation; generic errors never claim an earlier ambiguous request was not saved.

cases.name: Guarded undo and lost-ack undo retry
steps: After a strictly correlated accept2, request undo with a new key.
For the replay variant, verify real undo commit, lose the response and move same-source heads/null workspace before manual retry.
observe: Exact accepted receipt and undo key are retained through ambiguity and later known errors.
Actual rollback restores the accepted event original base, not its confirmation parent; new version/revision+1 and distinct event match all12 undo2 fields.
No second rollback on exact replay; rejection/receipt1/mismatched event/hash/key cannot supply undo authority.

cases.name: Cross-source, signed-out and foreign access
steps: Change to an actually different owned source while a request is in flight; separately use signed-out and a separately authorized foreign-owner session.
Visit owned/foreign input links and exercise same-origin POST rejection controls.
observe: Old local pending/accepted review clears and transport is aborted on actual source/access loss.
A late result never appears under the new source; abort does not claim server rollback.
No cross-owner read/write or cookie/token disclosure; endpoint origin/auth/ownership checks remain effective.

cases.name: Unsupported source, history and bounded coverage
steps: Use the old labelled source with a separately saved atomic Git JD; do not strip labels or edit a fact to imitate source evidence.
Open actual historical selected versions; separately prepare six actual Git clauses against the single neutral confirmed fact.
observe: Unsupported full-stream source supplies no v2 save authority even with a syntactically valid pair.
Historical preview stays pinned and no fresh decision workspace is substituted from current heads.
At most5 proposals/50 examined pairs; truncation is truthful and does not claim a full eligible total.

cases.name: Malformed transport, deadline and duplicate action
steps: Exercise approved response corruption: receipt1, wrong digest/event, non-JSON, invalidUTF8, oversized/stalled body and response loss.
Double-click an acknowledged action; check the source5s/65536-byte refusal behavior without inventing a browser latency SLA.
observe: Only correlated v2 success is shown; malformed/unknown outcomes preserve exact original payload/key.
Known recovery comes only from a strict HTTP envelope; a transport exception cannot forge it.
No auto-retry or duplicate dispatch; actual server transaction outcome requires independent verification.

cases.name: Accessibility, small viewport and JavaScript boundary
steps: Keyboard-test review selection, pinned links, acknowledgement, exact retry and undo; inspect focus/labels after state changes and persisted history restoration.
Apply existing authoring Axe and390px no-horizontal-overflow checks; inspect JavaScript-disabled rendering separately.
observe: Complete text remains readable; acknowledgements reset appropriately and controls have unique accessible labels.
Accessibility results are future observations, not currently passed evidence.
The v2 bridge depends on JavaScript verification; the old no-JavaScript legacy authoring test is not evidence of v2 save/undo. No legacy protocol fallback is introduced.
